prediction_text: Direction: Britain votes to Leave. In the referendum of 23 June 2016 the Leave side wins and the United Kingdom begins its exit from the European Union, against the February newspaper polls showing 'Stay' ahead with many undecideds. Uranus conjunct Ceres at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day is read as a disruptive rupture of the established order — the undecided bloc breaks toward change. Timing: result on referendum day, 23 June 2016.
basis:
This card has no tradition/system field; decided by genre as a mundane/natal-chart astrology assessment (Jessica Adams blog assessment, first published 5 July 2015, firmed 22 February 2016), using the UK national charts (1066, 1801, 1922) the card says are available.
Faces listed: main question answered; referendum-day configuration face (Uranus–Ceres conjunction at 23° Aries) is the trigger, read straight as disruption/change; polls-ahead-for-Stay face listed and answered against, on the card's own note of the vast 'not sure' bloc. Anchor check: the 23° Aries conjunction read straight; a reversed reading (conjunction = consolidation of the status quo) was listed and rejected, Uranus being the change significator in the snapshot's astro reference.
